title: Polycotyledon
summary: POLYCOTYL'EDON, noun [Gr. many, and a cavity.] In botany, a plant that has many or more than two cotyledons or lobes to the seed.

inlines.v: POLYCOTYL'EDON, noun [Gr. many, and a cavity.] In botany, a plant that has many or more than two cotyledons or lobes to the seed.
